description: This file defines interfaces and traits for data source integration in Apache Spark SQL, including relation providers, streaming sources, and data insertion mechanisms.

classes.name: DataSourceRegister
classes.description: Trait for data sources to register a short name alias.

classes.name: RelationProvider
classes.description: Trait for objects that produce relations for data sources based on parameters.

classes.name: SchemaRelationProvider
classes.description: Trait for data sources that produce relations with a user-defined schema.

classes.name: StreamSourceProvider
classes.description: Trait for objects that produce streaming sources.

classes.name: StreamSinkProvider
classes.description: Trait for objects that produce streaming sinks.

classes.name: CreatableRelationProvider
classes.description: Trait for objects that can create relations and support data type checks.

classes.name: BaseRelation
classes.description: Abstract class representing a collection of tuples with a schema.

classes.name: TableScan
classes.description: Trait for relations that can produce all tuples as an RDD.

classes.name: PrunedScan
classes.description: Trait for relations that can eliminate unneeded columns.

classes.name: PrunedFilteredScan
classes.description: Trait for relations that can eliminate columns and filter data.

classes.name: InsertableRelation
classes.description: Trait for relations that support data insertion.

classes.name: CatalystScan
classes.description: Trait for relations that can build scans with raw expressions.

classes.name: SupportsStreamSourceMetadataColumns
classes.description: Trait for stream sources that can add metadata columns.

methods.name: shortName
methods.description: Returns a string alias for the data source.

methods.name: createRelation
methods.description: Creates a new relation based on parameters.

methods.name: createRelation
methods.description: Creates a relation with a user-defined schema.

methods.name: sourceSchema
methods.description: Returns the name and schema of a streaming source.

methods.name: createRelation
methods.description: Creates a relation for data writing, with mode and parameters.

methods.name: supportsDataType
methods.description: Checks if a data type is supported for writing.

methods.name: buildScan
methods.description: Builds an RDD of all tuples.

methods.name: buildScan
methods.description: Builds an RDD with required columns.

methods.name: buildScan
methods.description: Builds an RDD with required columns and filters.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts data into the relation, with optional overwrite.

methods.name: buildScan
methods.description: Builds an RDD with required columns and filters, using expressions.

methods.name: getMetadataOutput
methods.description: Returns metadata columns for streaming sources.
